identity.description: Benchmark leaderboard agent: answers state-of-the-art questions ("what’s the SOTA on BCI IV-2a?") with ranked, self-reported results seeded from the corpus abstracts. LLM-free — pure retrieval from data/benchmarks.json, so every call is instant and nearly free.

inputs.description: A SOTA / leaderboard question, e.g. "What is the state of the art on BCI IV-2a?" or "all benchmarks"

outputs.description: Ranked leaderboard answer (self-reported numbers from corpus abstracts)
Cited papers behind the leaderboard entries as structured JSON (title, year, arXiv URL)

tags.name: Brain Technology
tags.description: Research on BCI, EEG decoding, neural decoding, connectomics and deep learning

tags.name: Research Assistant
tags.description: Answers questions with citations to a 215-paper arXiv corpus

tags.name: Benchmark Leaderboard
tags.description: State-of-the-art answers per dataset, seeded from corpus abstracts
